svg.aria-label: Pundoku app icon, direction D5 The Carry, small optics, light appearance
svg.title: Pundoku — D5 «Унос» — малая оптика — light
svg.desc: Small-size variant of the chosen D5 icon for nominal sizes 60 px and below. Same canvas, same palette, same composition bbox (224..800). Three geometry changes against d5-icon-light.svg: corridor 124 to 164, carried cell 164 to 176, radii 113/41 to 72/30, and the concave fillet 27 at the notch is removed (all three notch corners are sharp). Field and cell are flat fills sampled from the midpoints of the gradients they replace, so the rasterizer needs one gradient (the ground) instead of three. No filters.
